title: Wren and the Signal
author: Beatrix Joubert
blurb: Lena Joubert, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
